name: Anna Infrastructures Limited
about: Anna Infrastructures Limited engages in the real estate development business in India. The company operates through two segments, Real Estate Business; and Loan and Investment. The company develops residential, commercial, and social infrastructure projects. It also engages in loan and investment activities. The company was formerly known as Anna Finance Limited and changed its name to Anna Infrastructures Limited in April 2006. Anna Infrastructures Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Agra, India.
